statement: Plan TP-9 specifies transferring $1,450 to savings, locked until January, which would leave $150 available despite your $1,450 rent being due today.
judge_text:
WRONG

It states the transfer destination conflicts with the stated obligation: "$1,450 to savings, locked until January, which would leave $150 available despite your $1,450 rent being due today."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
